name: select
title: Select
description: A field that opens a stitched denim pocket of options.

.tx-select-item + .tx-select-item.background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--tx-thread) 50%, transparent) 0 5px, transparent 5px 9px)

.tx-select-item-indicator.background:
linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 40%, var(--_mark) 40% 60%, transparent 60%),
      linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent 40%, var(--_mark) 40% 60%, transparent 60%)
